name: AtlasIntel
notes: Site footer names the legal entity AtlasIntel Tecnologia de Dados Ltda. Mode is not stated on the source page: CNN Brasil describes the Atlas RDR (random digital recruitment) method with online questionnaires (https://www.cnnbrasil.com.br/eleicoes/pesquisa-atlas-cnn-entenda-como-funciona-metodologia-do-levantamento/) and HotNews reports the Romanian polls as 'recrutare digitală aleatorie'; verified=false for that reason.

name: INSCOP Research
notes: Founded 2013 per the source. CATI as stated in its own 2024 reports (e.g. https://www.inscop.ro/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/15.11.-Sondaj-INSCOP-LIBERTATEA.-Partea-a-II-a-Alegeri-Parlamentare.pdf); the source also mentions field, telephone and online data collection.

name: Centrul de Sociologie Urbană și Regională
notes: Face-to-face collection is described as PAPI/CAPI with CAPI adopted since 2016 (https://curs.ro/abordari-metodologice/culegerea-datelor-fata-in-fata/); the November 2024 national report states face-to-face at the respondent's home without naming CAPI or PAPI (https://curs.ro/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Prezentare-national-noiembrie-2024-public.pdf); the October 2024 national report states CATI (https://curs.ro/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Prezentare-national-octombrie-2024-telefonic-ponderate-CURS.pdf).

name: Grupul de Studii Socio-Comportamentale Avangarde
notes: The site lists CATI, PAPI and focus groups; the March 2025 presidential poll was reported as CATI (https://www.libertatea.ro/stiri/sondaj-avangarde-george-simion-crin-antonescu-nicusor-dan-alegeri-prezidentiale-2025-5244880).

name: Sociopol
notes: No current official website found (sociopol.ro did not resolve on 2026-11-22; Web Archive snapshots end in 2015). Legal name not verified. Mode CATI as reported for the 14-17 April 2025 poll.

name: Verifield
notes: Legal form Verifield SRL per the archived own site; the live site showed only a title page on 2026-11-22. Mode CATI per Digi24 (https://www.digi24.ro/alegeri-prezidentiale-2024/marcel-ciolacu-si-george-simion-in-turul-doi-la-prezidentiale-sondaj-comandat-de-usr-2968707) and Libertatea (own call centre, https://www.libertatea.ro/stiri/sondaj-verifield-calin-georgescu-crin-antonescu-nicusor-dan-5222382), not per an own report.

name: The Center for International Research and Analyses
notes: Mode CATI (telephone) per Newsweek România for the 9-13 November 2024 poll (https://newsweek.ro/politica/exclusiv-un-nou-sondaj-care-da-o-finala-ciolacu-ciuca-urmeaza-simion-si-lasconi-scorul-partidelor), not per an own report.

name: Biroul de Cercetări Sociale
notes: Own site states the 2024 national barometers were done by telephone; CATI per Newsweek România (https://web.archive.org/web/20241029172042/https://newsweek.ro/politica/exclusiv-sondaj-ciolacu-si-ciuca-in-turul-2-psd-31-pnl-205-cat-iau-simion-geoana-si-lasconi), which also states BCS was founded in February 1998.

name: ARA Public Opinion
notes: Full name American Romanian Association Public Opinion, established 2021, per the source, which lists TAPI, CATI (RDD) and CAWI services. 2025 polls reported by telephone (Antena 3 CNN, https://www.antena3.ro/politica/sondaj-ara-pentru-alegerile-prezidentiale-diferenta-foarte-mica-intre-george-simion-si-crin-antonescu-cine-e-pe-locul-3-741200.html) and CATI with RDD (report published by Cuget Liber, https://cugetliber.ro/upload/static/sondaj-prezident-1745830970.pdf).

name: Snap Market Research Plc
notes: Name and mode (CATI) from a press release of the commissioning association published by Oficiul de Știri. No official website verified; legal form and country of registration not verified.

name: FlashData
notes: Own site describes an AI-based tool that collects data from online sources and a 'digitally assisted sociological investigation'. 2025 polls were reported as an online questionnaire targeted by location, age and urban/rural, n=7,500 (Agerpres, https://agerpres.ro/politic/2025/04/07/prezidentiale2025-sondaj-flashdata-george-simion---28-crin-antonescu---26-nicusor-dan---23--1437990).

name: DataEcho
notes: Reports were hosted at results.dataecho.ro (unreachable on 2026-11-22; Web Archive copy used). The report states 'Recrutare digitală aleatorie' (random digital recruitment) without the interview channel, so typical_modes is empty. Legal name and website not verified.

name: IRSOP Market Research & Consulting
notes: Name from the site footer; the page title reads 'IRSOP Research & Consulting'. Telephone interviews per HotNews (https://hotnews.ro/cel-mai-recent-sondaj-irsop-ii-da-ca-finalisti-la-alegerile-prezidentiale-pe-george-simion-si-nicusor-dan-1949270), not per an own report.

name: MKOR
notes: CAWI through the firm's own online panel, per the methodology section of the source. Legal name not verified.

name: Noi, Cetățenii
notes: Results are published as Google Sheets linked from Wikipedia. The sheet describes a self-funded independent survey using 'extended digital recruitment' with statistical balancing; the interview channel is not stated, so typical_modes is empty. Name as shown in Wikipedia and sondajeromania.ro; the organisation and legal entity were not verified.
